## LuniOS 1.2.1 beta

### New: Luni Labs
A hidden page for experimental features. To unlock it, go to Settings > About phone and tap **LuniOS version** 7 times at a steady pace (about once per second). Luni Labs then shows up at the bottom of the LuniOS section. You can hide it again from inside the page.

### Experiment: Island notifications
When turned on in Luni Labs, incoming notifications appear in **Luna Island** instead of the regular pop-up:
- A glass card opens from the camera cutout with the app, title, message and avatar.
- Up to 3 action buttons from the app (e.g. Mark as read, Archive).
- Tap the card to open the app, swipe up to dismiss. The card closes on its own after 6 seconds, and the notification stays in the shade.
- Calls, alarms and the lock screen keep the regular style.
- Reply actions open the app for now. Inline replies are coming later.

### Notes
- Island notifications are experimental and off by default.

## LuniOS 1.2.0 beta

### New
- **Luna Island** – a live glass pill around the camera cutout that appears when something is going on: calls, timers and stopwatches, navigation, screen recording, media and plugging in the charger. When nothing is active, it hides. Tap to expand it into a glass card, tap the card to open the app, long-press to jump straight to the app.
- **Lock screen notification stack** – notifications on the lock screen now stack like cards: newest on top, older ones collapse into a stacked deck at the bottom with a "+N more" counter.
- **Glass everywhere** – liquid glass with blur and jelly press for the launcher long-press menu, shortcuts and drop targets, the share sheet, the volume panel, system dialogs and the power menu.

### Improved
- Settings: centered glass title pill, smooth scrolling under the top bar with no flicker.
- Updater: fresh update checks (no stale cache), no false "installation failed" after reboot.

### Notes
- Beta channel build. Your data is kept when you update over the air.

## LuniOS 1.1.1 Beta

A fix-up release for Settings and LuniOS Updates.

- **Settings:** lists now scroll smoothly under the transparent top bar. Rows no longer get cut off on a line or leave an empty frame, and they fade gently into the background near the top. The back button and the title pill always stay on top.
- **What's new screen:** after every update, the LuniOS logo rises like in the setup wizard and shows what changed in the new version.
- **LuniOS Updates:**
  - No more false "Installation failed" message after a successful update.
  - New releases show up right away, without waiting for the server cache.
  - Beta channel releases appear only when the Beta channel is selected.

## LuniOS 1.1 (testowa)

Pierwsza aktualizacja przez sieć, prosto z Ustawień.

- **Ustawienia:** karty płynnie przewijają się pod przezroczysty pasek. Koniec z ucinaniem wierszy na linii i pustą ramką u góry.
- **Pasek tytułu:** napis w szklanej pigułce na środku jest widoczny na każdej stronie.
- **Aktualizacje LuniOS:** sprawdzanie, pobieranie i instalacja w tle na drugi slot.
